submission.natural_language_explanation: Retrospective: the pole fires (0.7-1.5 of its 1.54 maximum, on the word itself or on the wh-word/complementizer immediately after it) on a word that grades a state or a claim rather than reporting a concrete event - a held degree of belief, understanding or feeling (doubt, suspect, wonder, puzzled, insight, interesting, sad, surprising, a constant reminder that) or an abstract quantity/extent or category qualification of a predication (the durative 'has long been', 'two types of tool'). It sits at its floor (0.05-0.3) on definite factual statements, concrete physical actions and committed reports or assertions (knocked, painted, carried, holds water, opened in 1893, insisted, promised, explained, said, told), so swapping only the predicate inside an otherwise identical frame moves the peak from about 1.0-1.5 down to about 0.1-0.6.
